description: CTF pwn challenge playbook — fast pwntools workflow against "nc host port" services: reproduce the remote environment locally with the provided libc/ld (patchelf, Docker), exploit format-string bugs (the CTF staple) for leaks and writes, and iterate a script from crash to flag. Load when the handout is a binary plus connection info. Signals: "pwn" category, nc host port, checksec output, provided libc.so.6/ld-linux, Dockerfile, "%p" reflections, menu-driven heap note apps.
